title: How blockchain is quietly revolutionizing supply chains

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What if blockchain's most profound impact isn't in finance, but in making supply chains transparent and ethical?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Today, blockchain enables real-time tracking of goods using IoT sensors and smart contracts on platforms like Hyperledger.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But without proper governance, data on the chain could be manipulated or used to exploit workers in opaque global networks.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are integrating AI audits and zero-knowledge proofs to verify data integrity without exposing sensitive information.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: In five years, we may see fully transparent, fair-trade supply chains where consumers trace a product's journey from farm to shelf.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future of supply chains lies in blockchain’s ability to merge trust, transparency, and accountability in real time.

video_cue: A transparent, digital ledger displayed alongside a global map showing the real-time movement of goods through supply chains.
